explication: InfluxDB 3 Core is a time-series database for ingesting, transforming, storing, and querying event data. Its principal workflow accepts HTTP writes, buffers and persists data as Parquet, then serves SQL, InfluxQL, and FlightSQL queries. The README documents these product capabilities; the sampled excerpts and source index establish several internal modules and references, but do not expose the full write/query wiring. Dashed edges mark those unverified connections rather than asserting a call sequence.
